request: Qualify independent server ownership and actual retirement under handshake impairment
scope: handshakeloss and handshakecorruption as candidate server
approval: User requested implementation and qualification of all remaining interoperability cases.
qualification: Bounded parallel admission runs each complete Hibana connection independently. Actual IdleExpired joins ordinary I/O and retires owned resources without pretending clean close. Initial ACKs carry retained ServerHello CRYPTO within the same 1200B padding budget, with ordinary congestion/amplification accounting and actual publication receipts. Handshake ACK buffering delay follows RFC9002 5.3. Corrected native per-client routing: three burst-loss runs and one burst-corruption run each matched all 50 file hashes and retired every owner (58.941/62.480/56.890/50.051 seconds). Isolated missing-feedback idle, client 0-RTT and key-update regressions pass. Core/host tests, thumb, host Clippy, limited Lean/Z3 pass. Earlier failed experiments remain unqualified. Require unchanged official controls and actual server verdicts before increasing the current 26/44 count.
